The scatter plot effectively highlights the differences in healthcare service utilization among the various demographic groups, suggesting a positive correlation between patient volume and utilization rate, particularly pronounced in the Adult and Geriatric service categories. The grid lines in the background enhance readability, allowing for easier comparison of the data points.

 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

data = {
    'Quarter': ['Q1 2022', 'Q1 2022', 'Q1 2022', 'Q1 2022',
                'Q2 2022', 'Q2 2022', 'Q2 2022', 'Q2 2022',
                'Q3 2022', 'Q3 2022', 'Q3 2022', 'Q3 2022',
                'Q4 2022', 'Q4 2022', 'Q4 2022', 'Q4 2022',
                'Q1 2023', 'Q1 2023', 'Q1 2023', 'Q1 2023',
                'Q2 2023', 'Q2 2023', 'Q2 2023', 'Q2 2023',
                'Q3 2023', 'Q3 2023', 'Q3 2023', 'Q3 2023',
                'Q4 2023', 'Q4 2023', 'Q4 2023', 'Q4 2023'],
    'Service_Type': ['Pediatric', 'Adult', 'Geriatric', 'Maternity',
                     'Pediatric', 'Adult', 'Geriatric', 'Maternity',
                     'Pediatric', 'Adult', 'Geriatric', 'Maternity',
                     'Pediatric', 'Adult', 'Geriatric', 'Maternity',
                     'Pediatric', 'Adult', 'Geriatric', 'Maternity',
                     'Pediatric', 'Adult', 'Geriatric', 'Maternity',
                     'Pediatric', 'Adult', 'Geriatric', 'Maternity',
                     'Pediatric', 'Adult', 'Geriatric', 'Maternity'],
    'Patient_Volume': [1200, 2100, 1800, 950,
                       1350, 2250, 1950, 1050,
                       1280, 2150, 1880, 1020,
                       1400, 2350, 2100, 1150,
                       1380, 2280, 2000, 1100,
                       1500, 2400, 2150, 1200,
                       1450, 2300, 2050, 1180,
                       1600, 2500, 2280, 1300],
    'Utilization_Rate': [15.2, 32.5, 28.3, 22.1,
                         17.1, 34.2, 30.1, 24.3,
                         16.4, 33.0, 29.5, 23.8,
                         18.0, 36.2, 32.0, 26.0,
                         17.5, 35.8, 31.2, 25.5,
                         19.2, 37.5, 33.4, 27.2,
                         18.3, 34.8, 30.9, 24.8,
                         20.1, 38.3, 34.2, 28.5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

quarter_order = ['Q1 2022', 'Q2 2022', 'Q3 2022', 'Q4 2022',
                 'Q1 2023', 'Q2 2023', 'Q3 2023', 'Q4 2023']
service_colors = {
    'Pediatric': '#4e79a7',
    'Adult': '#f28e2b',
    'Geriatric': '#e15759',
    'Maternity': '#76b7b2'
}

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))

for service in df['Service_Type'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Service_Type'] == service]
    plt.scatter(subset['Patient_Volume'],
                subset['Utilization_Rate'],
                color=service_colors[service],
                label=service,
                s=100,
                alpha=0.8,
                edgecolors='w',
                linewidth=0.5)

plt.title('Healthcare Service Utilization Rate vs. Patient Volume by Demographic Group', fontsize=14, pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Patient Volume', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Utilization Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
